subject: Chapter 74 Vocational Program Expansion Study
overview: The committee approved the Chapter 74 viability form to study expanding and adding vocational programs and reviewed a draft of the educational profile for the new high school. Members conducted a facility tour and discussed incorporating health clinics, nature integration, and improved athletic spaces into the building vision.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including minutes from the May 13 and May 29 meetings with clerical corrections to member names.

items.title: Building Walking Tour
items.summary: Conducted a tour of the current high school facility to assess building conditions and spatial limitations.

items.title: Chapter 74 Viability Form
items.summary: Approved the Chapter 74 viability form to study the expansion of four current vocational programs and the addition of five new trades, including veterinary science, plumbing, and cybersecurity.

items.title: Educational Profile Draft
items.summary: Reviewed the draft educational profile and assigned members to write sections regarding nature integration, athletic facilities, trauma-informed design, and in-school health services.

items.title: Project Schedule and Next Steps
items.summary: Outlined upcoming milestones for the MSBA eligibility phase, including a planned City Council vote to authorize funding for the feasibility study.
